confidence_notes: Restaurant meals, beer and coffee come from web searches of Numbeo-based aggregates (Numbeo page and an Expatica snapshot dated 1 June 2026), which are user-reported. Those figures were roughly £15 for an inexpensive meal, £62-66 for a mid-range meal for two, £5.3-5.5 for a pint and £3.46 for a cappuccino. I converted them to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.33 USD per GBP, which I did not look up. Cocktail and wine are less certain. Search results gave cocktails at about £7-9 (a 2025 Expatistan entry of £9, plus an older night-out survey) and wine at £5-8 a glass, so I set both a little above the older survey figures to allow for inflation. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no booking pages or listings checked, and are the least certain. Rates in July 2026 may be higher during events or concerts at Principality Stadium. The RBA rate is the latest figure found in search results, dated 18 Nov 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized UK regional cities such as Bristol and Leeds, with Cardiff priced slightly below London and a little below English cities of similar size.
